install_note: Node.js (node + npm on PATH) is required. Installs the Remotion render engine (react + @remotion/* pinned to 4.0.482) into skills/remotion/render-engine/node_modules via npm (~500 MB). The first render also downloads a Chrome Headless Shell (~90 MB) into the npm/puppeteer cache. CPU-only H.264 encoding, no GPU.
